title: Jean "Moebius" Giraud
description: "When STAR WARS first came out," remernbers Moebius, "I was ecstatic because it was exactly the kind of science fiction that I love...and I draw." Lauded in France for his luminous fantasy illustrations, Moebius has won every major international comics award and has even been honored with a stamp! Significant work includes ARZACH (1975), THE AIRTIGHT GARAGE (1979), HEAVY METAL contributions and Marvel's SILVER SURFER: PARABLE, with Stan Lee.
